# Upstream provenance

Vendored from [Absenti/iBuilder](https://github.com/Absenti/iBuilder), tag
`v0.1.2`, commit `104a2b754227cf040e77c20a368016c0fdb6a49c`.

The crate is the pure-Rust `ibuilder-macho` framework assembler. Its source
and MIT license are retained. CLI binaries and fixture-dependent oracle tests
are not included in this vendored library copy; upstream unit tests remain in
the source modules.
